unitRegression.scope: Entire test/unit/android suite, including persistent file-picker recovery and Android feature gates. Original command suite separately passed 86 tests; original Discord 5 and cover URL 3 passed previously. Not APK integration.

chromiumInteraction.scope: Predictive-back JavaScript cancellation and portal focus dispatch; floating-window drag regions and nested button exclusion. Native gestures and window movement not device-validated.

nodeRpcHostChecks.scope: Host Node server startup, desktop setting defaults, save-settings boolean normalization, rejection of invalid update lane, live update-disable status. Not Android Java/Node integration.

remainingDeviceValidation: settings persistence and native file access
scopeExclusions: Discord rich presence, explicitly excluded by user
sourcePortScope: Reviewed source integration, not a claim of device runtime parity

latestPhoneLayoutCheck.scope: Android browser branches: metadata width and compact player height, not device power or raster flicker
